name: io.github.WYRE-AI/datto-saas-protection-mcp
title: Datto SaaS Protection
description: MCP server for Datto SaaS Protection — read-only M365/GWS backup posture, seats, license usage.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_SAAS_PUBLIC_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Public API key from Partner Portal > Admin > Integrations > API Keys

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_SAAS_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Secret API key from Partner Portal > Admin > Integrations > API Keys

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_SAAS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional API origin override for proxies. Datto has a single host (https://api.datto.com); leave unset.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
